turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text: Well, that's a rather interesting question! IMAP, you see, stands for Internet Message Access Protocol. Think of it like this: with older email systems, your messages were just *downloaded* to your device. IMAP lets you access your emails directly on the server, so changes you make on one device sync up everywhere.
